capabilities.safeClaim: MartinLoop requires evidence from configured checks before completion counts.
MartinLoop detects configured out-of-scope changes, rejects the attempt and can restore the rollback boundary.
prohibitedClaims: Blocks every prohibited write before execution

capabilities.safeClaim: MartinLoop evaluates suspicious new tests and requires explicit approval when an attempt weakens or removes existing test code.
prohibitedClaims: Detects every form of test tampering

capabilities.safeClaim: MartinLoop provides guided setup for verifiers and run limits. Common ecosystems get discovery suggestions.
Every completed run produces a Verified Handoff with a deterministic outcome (VERIFIED / STOPPED / NEEDS_REVIEW) and inspectable evidence.
prohibitedClaims: Automatically proves the run is safe to merge

capabilities.safeClaim: MartinLoop enforces configurable USD and iteration budgets. Budget exits produce STOPPED outcomes.
MartinLoop can capture a rollback boundary before execution and restore it after a rejected patch.
prohibitedClaims: Guarantees complete rollback in all environments

capabilities.safeClaim: MartinLoop ships provider-free Swarm planning and evidence primitives; governed live fleet execution remains a separately qualified boundary.
prohibitedClaims: Fully autonomous governed fleet execution is generally available
